Tesbihat Pro privacy policy
Last updated: 7 November 2026

Tesbihat Pro is a free app. It needs no account and does not ask for your name, e-mail address or location.

Your counts
Your counts, dhikrs, daily history and settings are kept only on your device and are not sent to us. If Android backup is turned on, they may be included in the backup in your own Google account. To delete them, clear the app data or uninstall the app.

Advertising
The History and Settings screens show ads from Google AdMob. The tesbih and dhikr screens show no ads and request none. When you open History or Settings, the Google Mobile Ads SDK collects and shares the following for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention: your IP address, which may be used to estimate your general location; interactions such as app launches and taps; diagnostic information such as app launch time; and identifiers such as the Android advertising ID and app set ID. This data is encrypted in transit. Google handles and keeps it under its own rules: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

Your choices
You can turn ads off in Settings; while they are off, the app shows and requests no ads. Where the law requires it, the app asks for your consent before showing ads, and you can change your choice at any time under Privacy options in Settings. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your device settings.

Children
The app is not directed at children.

Changes and contact
Changes to this policy are published here. For questions: fbsonmezisik@outlook.com

Tesbihat Pro is a free app made as charity. It counts dhikr and the tesbihat after prayer, and shows the muezzin\'s duties for each prayer step by step.

Choose the prayer from the minaret icon or the menu. Each step tells you what to do and shows the text to read in Arabic, with its Turkish reading and, for short texts, its meaning. In the tesbihat step the tesbih counter opens from zero; when you finish, you return to the flow. The guide\'s religious texts and instructions are in Turkish.

This app is not an official app of the Presidency of Religious Affairs of Türkiye (Diyanet). Its religious content is prepared on the basis of Diyanet publications. The tesbihat counts follow the fatwa of Diyanet\'s High Board of Religious Affairs; the muezzin flows follow Diyanet\'s İslam İlmihali and Namaz İlmihali, its Religious Services Application Circular and the Hitabet ve Mesleki Uygulama course of the Ministry of National Education. The source of every text is written under it. If you notice a mistake, please write to us.
